is_anopheles.evidence: Indoor resting blood-fed Anopheles mosquitoes (An. funestus s.s. and An. gambiae s.s.) were collected in Mibellon, Cameroon (Page 1 & 2).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Genotyped GSTe2 L119F and RDL A296S in An. funestus s.s., as well as Vgsc L1014F (L995F), Vgsc L1014S (L995S), and Ace-1 G119S (G280S) in An. gambiae s.s. (Page 6).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Page 6 reports exact genotype counts/frequencies: GSTe2 L119F (N=110: 7 RR, 48 RS, 55 SS), RDL A296S (N=92: 3 RR, 12 RS, 75 SS), Vgsc L1014F (N=72: 22 RR, 48 RS, 2 SS), Vgsc L1014S (N=76: 0 RR, 3 RS, 73 SS), and Ace-1 G119S (N=50: 0 RR, 0 RS, 50 SS).

african_field_population.evidence: Adult blood-fed mosquitoes collected from houses in Mibellon, Cameroon in January 2017 (Page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study describing vector bionomics, insecticide susceptibility bioassays, and resistance marker genotyping at a field site in Cameroon.

sub_country_location.evidence: Mibellon village (6°46'N, 11°70'E), Adamawa region, Mayo Banyo Division, Bankim Sub-division, Cameroon (Page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Original field sampling conducted specifically for characterising the Mibellon experimental hut site in January 2017.

supplement.evidence: All primary genotype frequency counts and sample sizes are fully described in the main text of the article (Page 6).

assessment.summary: This study characterizes malaria vectors at Mibellon in central Cameroon. Field-collected F0 blood-fed Anopheles funestus s.s. and Anopheles gambiae s.s. were genotyped for key insecticide resistance markers including GSTe2 L119F, RDL A296S, Vgsc L1014F/S, and Ace-1 G119S. Susceptibility bioassays and PBO synergist tests were conducted on F1 offspring.
